Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for the claim file. Can you state your full name
for the record?
A: I'd rather just give you the details of what happened, if that's all right.
Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through how the collision occurred?
A: I was pulling out of a parking space at a shopping center in Pearland. I was going slowly, maybe walking speed,
when another vehicle backed out from the next row and struck the rear quarter panel of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: Not really. I heard someone honk, and then there was a bang. My head snapped forward and then back against
the seat.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle and speak with the other driver?
A: I did. The other driver apologized and said they didn't see me. We exchanged insurance information and took a
few photos of both cars.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They diagnosed whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some
medication. I've also started physical therapy twice a week.
Q: How are your symptoms today?
A: My neck is still stiff, and I get hedaaches toward the end of the day. Turning my head to check my blind spot when
driving is painful. I've had to take time off work to attend appointments.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add for the record?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm hoping to recover fully. I'll send over the medical records when I get them.
Q: Thank you for your cooperation. We'll be in touch.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
